_comment: scripts/validate-config-gen.sh used to be the rule for templates. It needs ~10 min
(it runs a full ansiblew render plus `docker compose config`) and the hook kills it
at 300s, so the rule could never go green -- and its check 3 is red at baseline
anyway (localhost in two DB URIs, unchanged since before this work). It stays a
manual check. What replaces it here is strictly more discriminating per second:
check-jinja-syntax parses every template, test-compose-includes proves every
compose include has a task that writes it, and the molecule scenarios RENDER the
real templates with real facts and cross-check that no depends_on names a service
no include provides, and that the bake targets asked for are targets the bake file
defines. ~2 min for all of it.

rules.run: python3 scripts/check-jinja-syntax.py && bash scripts/test-compose-includes.sh && VENV_MOLECULE=.venv-molecule .venv-molecule/bin/molecule test -s unit && VENV_MOLECULE=.venv-molecule .venv-molecule/bin/molecule test -s multihub
VENV_MOLECULE=.venv-molecule bash scripts/test-topologies.sh && VENV_MOLECULE=.venv-molecule bash scripts/test-hub-baseline.sh
